# City of Malden

## Meeting Minutes - Final

## License Committee

*Councillor Sica, Chair*
*Councillor Condon, Vice Chair*
*Councillor Colon Hayes*
*Councillor Simonelli*
*Councillor Taylor*

Tuesday, April 14, 2026 5:30 PM 215 Pleasant Street, Room 105, Malden, MA 02148

Watch the meeting with Teams: https://tinyurl.com/License-April-14

## Roll Call

*Also in attendance was Compliance Officers Dave Morse and Jim Tuxbury, Assistant City Solicitors Christopher Mooney and Zaheer Samee, and Assistant City Clerk Morgan Hunte.*

**Present:** 4 - Jadeane Sica, Paul Condon, Karen Colon Hayes and Ari Taylor

**Absent:** 1 - Chris Simonelli

## Minutes to be Approved

**201-26** Minutes from the meeting of March 17, 2026

A motion was made by Councillor Taylor, seconded by Councillor Colon Hayes, that the Committee Minutes be approved. The motion carried by a unanimous vote.

## Business

The Compliance Officers and Asst. City Clerk Hunte confirmed there were no issues with any of the following petitions.

Meeting adjourned at 5:42 PM.

headline: Recommended favorably to City Council fourteen license renewal petitions and approved March 17, 2026 minutes.
summary: The License Committee reviewed the minutes from its March 17, 2026 meeting and approved them by unanimous vote. It then considered fourteen license renewal petitions, including extended hours, vending machine, taxi driver, amusement machine, Class II, lodging house, outdoor parking, pool tables, pawnbroker, second-hand dealer, and self-service gas station licenses, and recommended each one favorably to the City Council by unanimous vote.
